themeDescription: Leaking milk, crushed bread & missing items

challenges.title: Milk packet leaked and soaked bakery items in grocery bag
challenges.shortDescription: Handle an angry shopper who opened delivery bag to find punctured milk pouch and ruined bread.
challenges.mission: Express immediate sincere regret, verify damaged items via quick photo or order id, and trigger instant replacement or full credit.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I just took the bag from your delivery boy, and milk was leaking everywhere! My bread and eggs are completely ruined. What kind of packing is this?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: clean replacement or instant refund without return hassle

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands why dairy and bakery are packed together without separator bag.
possibleSolutions: Express re-order dispatch with dedicated packaging
unacceptablePromises: Do not ask customer to clean and return leaking milk pouch.

challenges.title: Essential item missing from sealed 10-minute grocery bag
challenges.shortDescription: Resolve an issue where a 1kg basmati rice bag was billed but omitted during dark store bag sealing.
challenges.mission: Verify picking invoice, apologize for the missing staple, and initiate immediate separate courier bike dispatch.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Hello, I checked my delivery bag and the 1kg Basmati rice packet is missing, but it is charged on my invoice. My guests are arriving in 20 minutes!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting the rice delivered right now

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Explains that refund alone won't solve tonight's dinner; needs item delivered immediately.
possibleSolutions: Immediate full item refund plus compensation voucher
unacceptablePromises: Do not tell customer to wait 24 hours for internal investigation.
